**Maintainers only · Solo mantenedores**

- [ ] `npm test`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run example` pass in `engine/`.
- [ ] Docs updated in English and Spanish, with referential wording.
- [ ] Only made-up ids in tests and examples.
